principle_violations.reason: The Order class manages both order details and status management. The PaymentProcessor classes handle both payment processing and order status updates. SMSAuthorizer takes responsibility for both verification and state control of authentication.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate responsibilities by creating classes responsible for order item management and order status. For PaymentProcessor, handle payment logic separately from order status updates. Modify SMSAuthorizer to handle only the verification logic.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
